title: La Dolce Vita | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home!* In Desired Seacrest!* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Multiple Balconies and Porch Swing! * 4 Bikes Available!* Walk to the Beach* Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool * Snorkel the Grouper
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home!* In Desired Seacrest!* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Multiple Balconies and Porch Swing! * 4 Bikes Available!* Walk to the Beach* Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool * Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach! *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service **Snowbird Friendly**Snowbird Season runs from November thru February. For a quote, select an arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and a departure date (must be the 1st day of a subsequent month). Contact us for alternate date requests and further assistance! All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. **The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. **La Dolce Vita is a fully remodeled 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home located in the popular 30A community of Seacrest Beach. Situated about 700 yards from beach access and walking distance to Rosemary Beach, this stunning home offers a bright, open floor plan with gorgeous hardwood flooring downstairs, shiplap in the main living area, and a gourmet kitchen with granite counters and stainless-steel appliances! There is a guest bedroom on the first floor with a queen bed and private attached bathroom. The master bedroom on the second floor has a king bed, balcony access, and a private bathroom with a jetted tub and separate walk-in shower. The second floor also includes a queen bedroom, and a bunk room with twin bunks and twin trundle, sleeping up to 9 guests comfortably. Sip your beverage of choice on one of the covered porches, take a dip in the huge community pool, or ride the seasonal tram to the beautiful beaches! You will also find three dedicated parking spots, and a Pack 'n Play and booster seat with feeding tray for the children. Enjoy lasting memories by making La Dolce Vita your next beach vacation tradition!Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year!The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Twin Bunkbed with Twin Trundle*Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home.*Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
